reviews.t: VERY PLEASED WITH THIS DIFFUSER
reviews.x: I ordered the Aromela Bundle gift set with the Diffuser and Lavender essential oil and we love it! We use it in our sons' bedroom as he has ADHD and has difficulty relaxing before bedtime. The Lavender essential oil really helps! I love that you have the option to have the light on or off on the diffuser. It's very quiet when running and doesn't make any sound when it runs for a period of time and shuts off. My husband and I love it so much that we are going to order one for our bedroom. Highly

reviews.t: Love it! Works great.
reviews.x: I was honestly skeptical at first about aromela since they’re a relatively new brand. Turns out they really know what they’re doing! First of all, I love the fact that it comes with a bottle of essential oil, it got me using it right away!! The diffuser works great (mainly I like the fact that it’s very quiet and runs continuously for, like, forever…).

reviews.t: Good
reviews.x: I've only had this for a little while but so far so good. I love the variety of light colors that it ombrés into. Instructions are easy to follow and put together. Comes with a lavender essential oil already. It's really cute perfect size for my desk.

reviews.t: This is perfect for a large bedroom
reviews.x: This is perfect for a large bedroom! Just as described by seller! I originally bought two for my kids bedrooms and just purchased another for my bedroom! Will also be ordering more oils from them as well! Is really a great product!

reviews.t: Need more for bedrooms
reviews.x: Great product, gives the air a fresh clean scent

reviews.x: I have much more expensive diffusers than this one and I am pleased with how closely they compare with my others.  I purchased this as an additional diffuser/humidifier for my daughter's bedroom so I could stop moving diffusers room to room each night.  This is very effective and provides a cool light show that my daughter loves.  I have used both settings and like them both.  I plan to purchase one more for an additional room and have recommended to a few friends as well.  With so many small di

reviews.t: A nice bonus is the variety of colors the diffuser has ...
reviews.x: I ordered this diffuser because I wanted something small that I could use essential oils in.  I've had it for a few weeks now and use it nightly.  It dispenses just enough mist and a few drops of oil goes a long way.  Attach the power cord (which is decent length), add water (I use distilled), a few drops of essential oil and it's ready to go.  A nice bonus is the variety of colors the diffuser has available.  Set it to a color that suits your mood or let it change through all the colors.  Nice

reviews.t: Aromela Aroma Diffuser Wins!
reviews.x: The aromela aroma diffuser is a good deal for a good product.  Simply and efficiently built. Easy to put together and operate. The color variations are rich and it does a good job of diffusing - unlike some other diffusers/humidifying products which tend to get clogged/stop vaporizing.  The bundled essential oil is good quality and smells nice (not overwhelming or chemical smelling). Combined - this unit and the oil does an effective job of adding some humidity and scent to any room in your home

reviews.t: Wonderful product!  Ordering a second one....
reviews.x: I've only had this for 2 days and I'm already ordering another one for my teenager (who is obsessed with the Bath & Body Works plug ins for her room which give me a headache!).  It's so nice to change up the smell with a different oil/blend.  Kids LOVE the changing colors of the lamp.  I love that it's simple to use and portable.  It uses less oil than reed sticks and distributes an even flow.  I love the little mister that you can use as intermittent or continuous flow; such a wonderful product

reviews.t: The product arrived in good condition and packaged well
reviews.x: The product arrived in good condition and packaged well. It works great. i love that it automatically shuts itself off when its out of water. My daughter loves it next to her bed at night since its also a cool night light. The only thing I would say is get extra aromatherapy, since the lavender included is very weak and you can hardly smell it unless you pour in half the bottle. But I am happy with it so far. I have only had it a week, so I hope it continues to work for a long time.

reviews.t: Great diffuser
reviews.x: I just received this bundle yesterday and I immediately got it going.  The colors are very neat and have plenty of options based on your mood.  This  diffuser adequately worked in my bedroom and was almost too strong so I'm moving it out into our living area, which is a good thing!  I didn't expect it to be as powerful as it was and it is very quiet!  I let it run for 2 hours and it hadn't used up much of the water so it has a great running time before needing to be filled again.

reviews.t: Excellent buy in a diffuser bundle with lavender oil!
reviews.x: i me so very pleased with my Aromela diffuser! It had the main feature I was looking for (30 seconds in/30 off), and loved that it came with a good essential oil starter, lavender. I've used it 2 nights now and it has helped me sleep creating a peaceful/restful scent while I slept. Very quiet operation. Also, extremely quick shipping!! Hope it gives me years of use.

reviews.t: watched tha video for good measure, and voilà
reviews.x: Just received the Aromela diffuser today as a birthday gift from my daughter. With no prior aromatherapy experience, I read the very clear instructions, watched tha video for good measure, and voilà, the unit was quietly diffusing aromatic lavender. I am completely sold on this product and looking forward to trying the other essential oils.

reviews.t: Exceptional product at a great price!!!
reviews.x: This product is a great buy!! It is easy to maintain and operate, which I love. The included oil is of great quality and I plan to buy more oils in addition to another diffuser. Nice gift idea for someone else or better yet, yourself!!! Will see how it holds up to continuous use, otherwise I am happy I bought this.

reviews.t: I got this as a gift, now I want one for myself!
reviews.x: I love this!  The color-changing light is mesmerizing, and the mist works great for filling a small room with beneficial fragrance.  So easy to use.  It comes with a handy measuring cup and even includes a 10ml bottle of essential oil which makes it a great value (and a complete gift).

reviews.t: LOVE IT!
reviews.x: LOVE IT!!! I bought this as a gift for my mom. Just from the packaging you could tell that this is a legit US company. She’s been using it now consistently and it works as expected. I expect it to last for a very long time. The therapeutic essential oil smells really good as well!

reviews.t: arrived on time and love the colors of the night light
reviews.x: not completely impressed. arrived on time and love the colors of the night light. however, the water evaporates within 7 hours and is constantly having to be refilled every night. I also put the oils in with recommended drops and you can barely smell it. will not buy again

reviews.t: Good diffuser but no smell.
reviews.x: I like the diffuser itself. The warm colors are nice and the quietness of it. However, no matter how much essential oil I put in the diffuser, it doesn't smell unless I'm close to it. Is this normal for diffusers? The space is not very large that it's in.

reviews.t: Best gift ever
reviews.x: I bought this as a Christmas gift for my sister.  It was only one that came with an essential oil in my price range.  She loves it!  I think this was the most excited she was by any gift I've given her.  Thank you!!

claims.text: Customers frequently praise the diffuser as a great product and good value, often buying additional units as gifts or for other rooms.
Many reviewers love the variety of changing light colors, including the option to turn the light off.
Reviewers commonly note it is smaller than expected but still effective and easy to set up and use.
Several customers appreciate that it comes bundled with lavender essential oil, allowing immediate use.
A few reviewers mention the scent is only noticeable up close and that turning it off requires repeated button clicks.
